UNITED STATES SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE COMMISSION

FORM 10-K

HARBORLIGHT DATA INC

Item 1. Business

Harborlight Data Inc. collects and sells employment, income and consumer credit data to lenders and employers in the United States.

Our headquarters are near the offices of Tidewater Analytics in a business district that has grown quickly in recent years.

Competition

We compete with Tidewater Analytics and Quillfeather Systems in the market for consumer credit data and income verification.

Customers

Quillfeather Systems accounted for 12% of our revenue in 2025 under a multi-year data licensing contract.

Technology

We rely on AWS to host our data platform under an agreement that runs through 2028.

Item 1A. Risk Factors

Summit conditions in our Target markets may change what our suppliers charge us, and we may not be able to pass those costs on.

We depend on a limited number of data suppliers, and the loss of any one of them could harm our business.

Item 3. Legal Proceedings

In 2024 Tidewater Analytics filed a complaint against us in federal court alleging infringement of two of its patents.

Item 9A. Controls and Procedures

Our management concluded that our disclosure controls and procedures were effective as of December 31, 2025.
